hypothesis: starter contact-quality profile adds signal beyond team form
verdict: WITHIN NOISE - not shipped to production
interpretation: Rolling 10-start contact quality is largely redundant with the team run-prevention and SP run-support features already present. AUC improved very slightly (+0.0023) which hints at marginal ranking information, but accuracy did not move and the change is far inside the +/-1.09% confidence interval. Shipping it would add 24 features and a fragile ID crosswalk for no measurable accuracy gain.
bugs_found_and_fixed: aggregate() OOM-killed silently on 3.4M pitch rows; rewrote to reduce each cached chunk to pitcher-game rows before concatenating
Savant CSV endpoint hard-caps at 25,000 rows and truncates without error; added cap detection with recursive window splitting
2026 rows key starters by MLBAM ID while Retrosheet seasons use retro IDs; merge silently dropped all 2026 coverage until keyed on both
kept: scripts/pitcher_statcast.py and the Chadwick crosswalk remain in the repo so the experiment is reproducible and can be revisited with matchup-specific features (platoon splits, lineup-vs-pitch-type), which this test did not cover.
